scope: Paired training of bounded achromatic component heads on a frozen Corpus 100k model

state.training: Complete for all three corrected pairs of context heads
state.evaluation: Complete on the scoped photo and wire panels
state.native_visual_review: Complete for two exact targets and eight standing GFX views

paired.optimizer: AdamW, 24 update warmup, .001→.0001 cosine, decay .001, gradient cap 2, EMA .99
paired.loss: Absolute true complex residual for present/attenuated + .65 paired difference + .50 absolute flat residual + .70 flat-core correction energy. Both heads have exactly the same samples and initialization.
paired.policy: FP32 component. Two outputs train jointly with no parameter sharing, same geometry and seeds.

aligned.optimizer: AdamW, 24 update warmup, .001→.0001 cosine, decay .001, gradient cap 2, EMA .99
aligned.loss: Absolute true complex residual for present/attenuated + .65 paired difference + .50 absolute flat residual + .70 flat-core correction energy, plus weight 9 on squared error aligned with the exact paired increment. Both heads have exactly the same samples and initialization.
aligned.policy: FP32 component. Two outputs train jointly with no parameter sharing, same geometry and seeds.

broad.optimizer: AdamW, 24 update warmup, .001→.0001 cosine, decay .001, gradient cap 2, EMA .99
broad.loss: Absolute true complex residual for present/attenuated + .65 paired difference + .50 absolute flat residual + .70 flat-core correction energy, plus weight 9 on squared error aligned with the exact paired increment. Both heads have exactly the same samples and initialization.
broad.policy: FP32 component. Two outputs train jointly with no parameter sharing, same geometry and seeds.

parent_feature_cache.precision: standard GPU FP16 autocast, FP32 output

superseded_attempt.disposition: Superseded. The packed Bayer indices did not preserve signed frequencies on the native grid.
